samples.title: SQL Data Warehouse free trial lab
samples.summary: PolyBase external data sources, external file formats and external tables over Azure Blob Storage.

provision.reason: Targets a dedicated Azure Synapse SQL pool: the scripts use CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE over Azure Blob Storage, CTAS with distribution hints, and Synapse-only resource classes. None of it runs on a SQL Server container, and there is no local equivalent to substitute.

samples.title: Plan comparison

provision.reason: Ships no SQL. The offline half is two .sqlplan files opened in SSMS; the Query Store half is a Windows .exe plus a .bacpac that needs SqlPackage and an Azure SQL Database target.

samples.title: Query Tuning Assistant
samples.summary: The SSMS Query Tuning Assistant walkthrough after a compatibility-level upgrade.

provision.reason: Ships a single qta-demo.zip of SSMS workload artifacts, with no SQL script to install. The walkthrough is driven from the SSMS UI.

samples.title: Azure SQL Edge demos
samples.summary: IoT and ONNX scoring demos for Azure SQL Edge.

provision.reason: The folder is a readme that redirects to the separate microsoft/sql-server-samples Azure SQL Edge repository; it contains no scripts of its own, and the demos need the Azure SQL Edge image rather than SQL Server.

samples.title: HR - Human Resources
samples.summary: The small introductory schema: 7 tables, a view, 2 procedures and a trigger. The best first thing to look at in the catalog.

samples.title: CO - Customer Orders
samples.summary: The modern e-commerce schema, including JSON columns for semi-structured order data.

samples.title: SH - Sales History
samples.summary: The star-schema warehouse: fact and dimension tables, materialized views and partitioning - the richest lineage of the three supported Oracle schemas.

samples.title: OE - Order Entry (archived)
samples.summary: The intermediate-complexity schema, with object types, XMLType and spatial columns.

provision.reason: Archived upstream and no longer maintained. Unlike HR/CO/SH there is no <schema>_install.sql driver: installing it means running a dozen scripts in order, importing PurchaseOrders.dmp with Data Pump, loading .dat files with SQL*Loader and registering XDB resources - none of which the upstream repository automates or still tests.

samples.title: OC - Online Catalog (archived)
samples.summary: Object-relational views and types built on top of the OE schema.

provision.reason: Archived upstream, and built inside the OE schema (the oc_*.sql scripts live in order_entry/) - so it inherits every OE prerequisite above.

samples.title: PM - Product Media (archived)
samples.summary: Print-media LOB types: images, audio, video and formatted documents.

provision.reason: Archived upstream. Its data is binary media loaded with SQL*Loader through LOB control files, and its column types depend on Oracle Multimedia, which was desupported in 19c and is absent from Oracle Database Free 23ai.
